style: Style: hand-drawn 2D vintage educational cartoon, bold slightly imperfect dark brown outlines, rounded hand-inked linework, flat colors with minimal cel shading, warm brown skin with peach highlights, palette of steel grey and safety orange accents, low saturation, vintage textbook look with clean digital coloring. Plain flat light grey (#E9ECEF) background, no scenery, figure centered with generous space around it. No text, no letters, no signs, no labels. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, not Pixar, not watercolor. No extra objects, no extra fingers.
